sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER-AIR PATTERN WILL CONTINUE TO BE CHARACTERIZED BY PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVES EMBEDDED WITHIN...AND DOWNSTREAM FROM...BELT OF NEARLY ZONAL FLOW CROSSING N PAC AND WRN CONUS. LEADING PERTURBATION -- NOW MANIFEST AS CLOSED CYCLONE OVER MO -- IS FCST TO MOVE ENEWD TOWARD NRN OH THROUGH PERIOD. TRAILING 500-MB TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD OVER LOWER MS VALLEY REGION EARLY IN PERIOD...THEN PIVOT EWD OVER SRN APPALACHIANS...GA AND NERN GULF BY 27/12Z. ASSOCIATED SFC CYCLONE -- ITS CENTER ANALYZED AT 26/04Z BETWEEN STL-IRK -- IS FCST TO BECOME ELONGATED ALONG QUASISTATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE THAT WILL LIE ACROSS ST LAWRENCE VALLEY AND LOWER GREAT LAKES. COLD FRONT SHOULD MOVE EWD ACROSS LOWER OH VALLEY...TN VALLEY REGION AND MUCH OF MS. FARTHER NW...STG SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER NWRN NV AND ERN ORE -- WILL BECOME EVEN MORE NEGATIVELY TILTED THROUGH PERIOD AS IT MOVES NEWD ACROSS NRN ROCKIES. PERTURBATION WILL EVOLVE INTO CLOSED 500-MB LOW OVER MT BY 27/12Z...WITH NARROW BUT INTENSE UPPER JET CORE -- MAX IN 140-150 KT RANGE AT 250 MB -- FROM SRN ORE TO WRN CO-WY BORDER. STG LEE-SIDE SFC TROUGHING WILL OCCUR IN ADVANCE OF THESE FEATURES. TRAILING PORTION OF ERN CO

sections.title: INTERIOR MID-ATLANTIC TO WRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP MIDDAY THROUGH AFTERNOON AND MOVE EWD OVER THIS REGION...IN ENVIRONMENT OF MOST ROBUST DEEP-LAYER ASCENT AND DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF MID-UPPER PERTURBATION. CONSIDERING UPSTREAM MOISTURE NOW OBSERVED...SOME MODELS -- E.G. A COUPLE OF SREF MEMBERS ALONG WITH ETA-KF AND ITS FCST SOUNDINGS -- APPEAR OVERDONE IN DEVELOPING UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S SFC DEW POINTS AS FAR N AS NRN NY. STILL...STRONGER CONFIDENCE EXISTS IN MID-60S DEW POINTS OVER MUCH OF CENTRAL/ERN PA AND WRN/NRN NY S OF QUASISTATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE. THIS...IN TANDEM WITH FAVORABLY STEEP MID-UPPER LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND SFC HEATING...MAY YIELD 2000-3500 J/KG PRECONVECTIVE MLCAPE BY MID-AFTERNOON. VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES WILL FAVOR SUPERCELL EVOLUTION...SIGNIFICANT HAIL RISK AND PERHAPS A FEW TORNADOES FOR ANY RELATIVELY DISCRETE STORMS...WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES 35-45 KT AND 0-3 KM SRN 150-250 J/KG. LINEAR/BOW/LEWP MODES ARE EXPECTED...WITH RISK OF DAMAGING GUSTS.

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO MS/AL
sections.text: WRN PORTION OF OUTLOOK AREA FROM OH-AL IS MORE UNCERTAIN GIVEN QUESTIONS ABOUT SUFFICIENT AIR MASS RECOVERY BEHIND COLD POOL CAUSED BY SVR QLCS NOW APCHG/ENTERING THAT CORRIDOR. EXCEPT OVER ANY REMAINING PRE-QLCS AIR MASS IN GA/AL/MS...ANY DEVELOPMENT THAT CAN OCCUR INVOF COLD FRONT WILL ENCOUNTER REDUCED BUT STILL POTENTIALLY SUFFICIENT MOISTURE RELATIVE TO THAT ADVECTING NWD FROM VA/DELMARVA INTO MID-ATLANTIC.

sections.title: FL PENINSULA
sections.text: SEA BREEZE BOUNDARIES...AND SUBSEQUENT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOWS...WILL BECOME FOCI FOR SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON IN ENVIRONMENT OF 1500-2500 J/KG MLCAPE. WELL-MIXED SUBCLOUD LAYERS IN INTERIOR PENINSULA FOR MUCH OF AFTERNOON MAY FOSTER STG OR PERHAPS DAMAGING GUSTS...AND ISOLATED/MRGL SVR HAIL IS POSSIBLE. DOMINANT CONVECTIVE MODE SHOULD BE MULTICELLULAR...GIVEN WEAKNESS OF DEEP-LAYER WINDS AND SHEAR.

sections.title: CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS MAY DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY EVENING INVOF LOW-LEVEL LEE TROUGH AND RELATED CONVERGENCE ZONE. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND LOWER-TROPOSPHERIC SHEAR EACH WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS/BOW STRUCTURES. LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL BE MRGL BUT ADEQUATE FOR CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL WITH SFC DEW POINTS 40S F AWAY FROM HIGHER TERRAIN. PACE AND INTENSITY OF SFC HEATING MAY BE MUTED SOMEWHAT BY PRESENCE OF HIGH CLOUD COVER PRECEDING UPPER TROUGH. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND GUSTS NEAR SVR LEVELS ARE POSSIBLE. ..EDWARDS/HURLBUT.. 05/26/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: IL CLOSED LOW EXPECTED TO CONTINUE SLOWLY EWD TODAY AND DEVOLVE INTO AN OPEN WAVE AS BELT OF STRONGER NWLY FLOW ON WRN SIDE OF SYSTEM /NOW OVER OK/ CONTINUES SEWD AND SLIGHTLY AMPLIFIES ASSOCIATED TROUGH EXTENDING S INTO THE TN VLY. THIS PATTERN WILL MAINTAIN DEEP SSWLY FLOW OVER THE ERN U.S. FARTHER W...IMPULSE ASSOCIATED WITH LEADING EDGE OF STRONG ZONAL JET FROM THE PACIFIC WILL MOVE FROM THE NRN RCKYS TO THE NRN HI PLNS LATER TODAY...BEFORE EVOLVING INTO AN ELONGATED LOW OVER NRN MT EARLY FRI. AT THE SFC...LOW ASSOCIATED WITH IL UPR SYSTEM SHOULD WEAKEN AS IT CONTINUES SLOWLY E INTO OH TODAY...WHILE FRONT EXTENDING NEWD FROM LOW REMAINS NEARLY STNRY ACROSS THE LWR GRT LKS/ST LAWRENCE VLY. THIS FRONT...AS WELL AS WEAKENING COLD FRONT EXTENDING SW FROM THE LOW...AND RESIDUAL CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES IN WARM SECTOR...WILL SERVE TO FOCUS POTENTIALLY STRONG TO SVR STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER PARTS OF THE EAST AND SOUTH TODAY.

sections.title: CNTRL APPALACHIANS TO NERN STATES
sections.text: DESPITE WEAK FORCING FOR ASCENT...SCTD TSTMS EXPECTED TO FORM WITH SFC HEATING BY MIDDAY AND PERSIST THROUGH THIS EVE ALONG AFOREMENTIONED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SEGMENTS FROM THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS NEWD INTO UPSTATE NY. THESE STORMS SHOULD MOVE GENERALLY NEWD IN BELT OF ENHANCED FLOW BETWEEN WRN EDGE OF OFFSHORE RIDGE AND IL UPR LOW. AMPLE MOISTURE /PW AROUND 1.25 IN/ WILL EXIST TO SUPPORT STRONG STORMS...AND PROXIMITY OF RESIDUAL EML WILL ENHANCE MID LVL LAPSE RATES SUCH POCKETS OF SBCAPE AOA 2500 J/KG MAY DEVELOP... ESPECIALLY OVER CNTRL/ERN PA INTO NY S OF STNRY FRONT. THIS...ALONG WITH SFC HEATING...MAY SUPPORT A FEW SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL. GIVEN RELATIVELY FAST MEAN FLOW...WITH 35-45 DEEP SWLY SHEAR AND SIZABLE LOW LVL SHEAR...A FEW TORNADOES ALSO MAY OCCUR...ESPECIALLY WITH ANY MORE DISCRETE STORMS. WITH TIME THE STORMS SHOULD EVOLVE INTO SEVERAL BROKEN BANDS...WITH SMALL BOWS/LEWPS POSSIBLY YIELDING DMGG WIND.

sections.title: MS/AL INTO OH VLY
sections.text: WEAKER DEEP SHEAR BUT AT LEAST MODEST FORCING FOR ASCENT /ASSOCIATED WITH TROUGH EXTENDING S FROM IL UPR LOW/ WILL CHARACTERIZE REGION FROM MS-AL NWD INTO PARTS OF THE TN AND OH VLYS TODAY. AIR MASS RECOVERY LIKELY WILL REMAIN LIMITED IN THE OH VLY...BUT STRONGER INSTABILITY MAY DEVELOP WITH HEATING OVER MS/AL AND THE SRN APPALACHIANS. MORNING SOUNDINGS /E.G. KBMX/ SHOW LITTLE CINH...SUGGESTING THAT ONSET OF DIURNAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IN AT LEAST THAT REGION WILL OCCUR RATHER EARLY. RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SEGMENTS AND CONFLUENCE BANDS MOVING GENERALLY EWD WITH UPR TROUGH WILL SERVE TO FOCUS STORM DEVELOPMENT. AMPLE SHEAR AND INSTABILITY WILL EXIST FOR SUSTAINED STORMS/MARGINAL SUPERCELLS...WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR DMGG WIND/HAIL AS THEY ORGANIZE INTO SHORT BANDS/CLUSTERS. SUFFICIENT LOW LVL SHEAR AND MOISTURE ALSO MAY BE PRESENT FOR TORNADOES...ESPECIALLY IN ERN TN/NRN AL /REF MCD 977/.

sections.title: CNTRL/NRN HI PLNS
sections.text: SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW OVER ID WILL ROTATE ENE AND ASSUME AN INCREASINGLY NEGATIVE TILT TODAY...ENHANCING UVV OVER THE NRN HI PLNS DURING MAX HEATING AS ATTENDANT 50+ KT MID LVL JET STREAK REACHES ERN WY. ISOLD TO WIDELY SCTD TSTMS SHOULD FORM THIS AFTN AND EVE NEAR ASSOCIATED LEE TROUGH...WHERE BOTH DEEP SHEAR AND LWR TROPOSPHERIC FLOW WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS/BOWS. LOW LVL MOISTURE WILL BE MODEST /DEWPOINTS IN THE IN THE 40S F WITH PW AROUND .75 IN/...BUT SUFFICIENT FOR STORMS. WHILE HIGH LVL CLOUDS WILL SOMEWHAT LIMIT SFC HEATING...A FEW STORMS MAY YIELD SVR HAIL AND PERHAPS STRONG WINDS THROUGH NIGHTFALL.

sections.title: FL PENINSULA
sections.text: SEA BREEZE BOUNDARIES...STRONG SFC HEATING...AND RELATIVELY COOL MID LVL TEMPS SHOULD FOSTER SCTD DIURNAL STORMS IN WEAKLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT OVER THE FL PENINSULA TODAY...WHERE SBCAPE SHOULD REACH 2000 J/KG. WELL-MIXED SUB CLOUD LAYERS MAY FOSTER A FEW STRONG /PERHAPS LOCALLY DMGG GUSTS...AND/OR ISOLD HAIL. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 05/26/2011

sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES/NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: A BELT OF STRONG /50-70 KT/ 500 MB FLOW WILL BE MAINTAINED ACROSS THE REGION TODAY IN ADVANCE OF OPENING MIDLEVEL LOW TRANSLATING ACROSS THE OH VALLEY. IN THE LOW LEVELS...PRIMARY SURFACE LOW AND ATTENDANT COLD FRONT WILL REMAIN W OF REGION THROUGH THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE. IT APPEARS THAT PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH/CONFLUENCE ZONE OVER CNTRL PA/NY AND REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM LAST NIGHT/S STORMS WILL SERVE AS THE FOCUS FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. LATE MORNING SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS AN AXIS OF 65-70 F DEWPOINTS EXTENDING FROM THE MID ATLANTIC PIEDMONT AND COASTAL PLAIN INTO CNTRL NY. WHEN COUPLED WITH ABUNDANT SUNSHINE...AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF 2000-3500 J/KG. WHEN COUPLED WITH 40-50 KT OF DEEP SWLY SHEAR...SETUP WILL FAVOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES WITH A RISK FOR VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND TORNADOES. THE GREATEST TORNADO THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FROM N-CNTRL/NERN PA INTO THE MID/UPPER HUDSON VALLEY WHERE LOCALLY BACKED NEAR GROUND WINDS WILL SERVE TO ENHANCE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN APPALACHIANS TO CNTRL/ERN GULF COAST
sections.text: MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF TSTMS ARE PRESENT THIS MORNING FROM MIDDLE/ERN TN TO FAR SERN MS/SWRN AL. ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH A CORRIDOR OF HEIGHT FALLS/FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO SHORT WAVE TROUGH TRANSLATING EWD THROUGH THE TN AND MID MS VALLEYS. 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS INDICATE THAT AMBIENT WARM SECTOR AIR MASS ACROSS MS/AL/GA IS MOIST AND ALREADY MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF 2000-2500 J/KG. CONTINUED HEATING OF BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT FURTHER DESTABILIZATION THIS AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE RISING ABOVE 3000 J/KG WITH A CORRESPONDING INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY. MIDLEVEL HEIGHT GRADIENT IS FORECAST TO RELAX WITH TIME FROM S-N ACROSS THE REGION...RESULTING IN A GRADUAL DECREASE IN VERTICAL SHEAR THIS AFTERNOON. NONETHELESS...DEEP-LAYER WIND FIELD WILL REMAIN SUFFICIENTLY STRONG /GIVEN THE INSTABILITY/ TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING...SUPERCELLS AND LINE SEGMENTS...WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARDS BEING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: EXIT REGION OF STRONG UPPER-LEVEL JET STREAK WILL PROPAGATE INTO REGION INTO THE REGION TODAY...ENHANCING DEEP-LAYER ASCENT BY AFTERNOON ALONG INTENSIFYING LEE TROUGH. BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 40S WILL TEND TO LIMIT THE POTENTIAL FOR MORE ROBUST DESTABILIZATION THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. HOWEVER...THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LOW TO MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WILL SUPPORT THE THREAT FOR A FEW ROTATING STORMS CAPABLE OF MAINLY SOME HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS. ..MEAD/GRAMS.. 05/26/2011

sections.title: SRN APPALACHIANS TO CENTRAL/ERN GULF COAST
sections.text: SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN MAINTAINED ACROSS THIS REGION WITH AN EWD EXPANSION OF THIS RISK AREA INTO MORE OF SERN AL...CENTRAL/NERN GA AND THE WRN CAROLINAS. THIS EXPANSION INCLUDES THE EWD EXTENSION OF 15 AND 30 PERCENT SEVERE WIND PROBABILITIES AND 15 PERCENT HAIL PROBABILITIES. REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED AN EVOLVING LINE OF STORMS LOCATED OVER ERN/SERN AL AND LIKELY ATTENDANT TO A LOWER LATITUDE IMPULSE BEGINNING TO MOVE ENEWD ACROSS SRN AL. THIS ACTIVITY WILL TRACK NEWD...POSING A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: LOWER MS TO LOWER OH VALLEYS
sections.text: GIVEN EWD PROGRESSION OF THE LOWER OH VALLEY SURFACE LOW AND TRAILING COLD FRONT...MINOR ADJUSTMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE WRN EXTENT OF LOWER SEVERE PROBABILITIES AND GENERAL TSTM LINE ACROSS THESE AREAS.

sections.title: NORTH CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ALTHOUGH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR HAS INCREASED AND WOULD SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS...HIGH LEVEL CLOUDS SPREADING EWD ACROSS THIS REGION PER SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOULD CONTINUE TO INHIBIT STRONGER SURFACE HEATING AND THUS RESULT IN MARGINAL INSTABILITY. GIVEN THESE FACTORS...HIGHER SEVERE PROBABILITIES AND A CATEGORICAL RISK ARE NOT WARRANTED AT THIS TIME. ..PETERS.. 05/26/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1116 AM CDT THU MAY 26 2011/

sections.text: PROGRESSIVE UPPER AIR PATTERN ACROSS CONUS FEATURES TWO PRIMARY AREAS OF TROUGHING AND RELATED SVR POTENTIAL IN ORDER OF PROBABILITIES...

sections.title: ERN CONUS
sections.text: MID-UPPER CYCLONE OVER INDIANA IS IN PROCESS OF DEAMPLIFYING INTO OPEN-WAVE TROUGH. TRAILING SHORTWAVE TROUGH...WHICH WILL MOVE EWD OVER KY/TN OVERNIGHT...IS NEARLY IN PHASE WITH SMALLER PERTURBATION NOW OVER SERN LA/SRN MS REGION. GULF COAST SHORTWAVE IS FCST TO MOVE EWD ACROSS NERN GULF...FL PANHANDLE AND GA BY 12Z. 23Z SFC ANALYSIS SHOWED RELATED SFC CYCLONE OVER NRN OH...FCST TO DRIFT ERRATICALLY AND WEAKEN THROUGH REMAINDER PERIOD AS UPPER WAVE DEPARTS. SFC COLD FRONT -- ANALYZED FROM THAT LOW SSWWD OVER ERN PORTIONS KY/TN AND SRN MS -- SHOULD DECELERATE/WEAKEN THROUGH REMAINDER PERIOD. REMNANTS OF FRONT SHOULD EXTEND FROM ERN OH TO WRN PANHANDLE OF FL BY 12Z. BKN BAND OF TSTMS FROM WV SSWWD ACROSS WRN CAROLINAS TO GA WILL POSE PRIMARY WIND/HAIL THREATS FOR A FEW MORE HOURS BEFORE DIMINISHING WITH LOSS OF DIABATIC SFC HEATING. THREAT BECOMES MORE ISOLATED FARTHER SW TOWARD GULF COAST AND SWD ALONG GA SEA BREEZE. MEANWHILE...IN STRONGER DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES OVER MID-ATLANTIC AND NEW ENGLAND...MIXTURE OF STORM MODES INCLUDING SEVERAL CLUSTERS AND SUPERCELLS WILL AFFECT AREAS ACROSS ERN PA/NJ/NY NEWD OVER PORTIONS WRN/NRN NEW ENGLAND. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD WEAKEN MORE GRADUALL

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STRONGLY NEGATIVELY TILTED SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER WRN MT WILL BECOME CLOSED CYCLONE AT 500 MB AND MOVE SLOWLY NEWD TO NEAR MT/AB BORDER OVERNIGHT. STG/ZONAL MID-UPPER JET CORE WILL EXTEND EWD FROM SRN ORE/NRN CA ACROSS CENTRAL ROCKIES...S OF MT SYSTEM. PRECEDING LOW-LEVEL COLD FRONT -- NOW ARCHING FROM NWRN CO TO ERN WY TO NERN MT -- WILL OVERTAKE FOREGOING LEE TROUGHING AND MOVE EWD ACROSS WRN/CENTRAL DAKOTAS...WRN NEB AND ERN CO THROUGH REMAINDER PERIOD. THIS FRONT...LEE TROUGH...AND OVERNIGHT WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT TO LFC...WILL BE PRIMARY FOCI FOR CONVECTION. SVR POTENTIAL APPEARS MRGL ATTM DUE TO LACK OF MORE ROBUST LOW-LEVEL THETAE...AND ISOLATED/CONDITIONAL WHERE MOST FAVORABLE SHEAR/CAPE OVERLAP IS EVIDENT FROM NERN CO NWD OVER WRN NEB PANHANDLE. ..EDWARDS.. 05/27/2011
